stem.text: The diagram shows a car travelling at a constant speed in a straight line between person P and person Q from point X to point Y.

stem.alt: Diagram of a car on a horizontal line with person P standing to its left and person Q standing to its right. An arrow along the line runs from point X to point Y. Printed labels: person P, X, Y, person Q.

stem.text: The car sounds its horn continuously as it travels. The horn emits sound of constant frequency.
Which statements about what person P and person Q hear during the motion of the car are correct?

items: Person P hears a sound of increasing frequency.
Person Q hears a sound of decreasing frequency.
Person Q always hears a sound of higher frequency than person P.
